name: theme-fix
description: Replace hardcoded colors with dynamic ArcColors/TvColors across all UI widgets

members.name: widgets-agent
members.prompt:
Replace hardcoded accent and surface colors with dynamic theme-aware colors in 4 files.

Project root: /Users/satori/Documents/Development/ArcPlayer/IPTV

**New API available** (already created and exported):
- `TvColors.accent(context)` — returns active accent color from theme
- `TvColors.accentFill(context)` or `TvColors.accentFill(context, alpha: 0.3)` — low-opacity accent
- `TvColors.accentSec(context)` — secondary accent
- `TvColors.bg(context)` — background
- `TvColors.surf(context)` — surface
- `TvColors.surfElev(context)` — elevated surface
- `TvColors.cardDyn(context)` — card color
- `TvColors.border(context)` — subtle border
- `TvColors.txt(context)` — primary text
- `TvColors.txtSub(context)` — secondary text
- `TvColors.txtMuted(context)` — muted text
- `ArcColors.of(context).sidebarTop` / `.sidebarBottom` — sidebar gradient
- Import is already available via existing `import '../theme/tv_colors.dart'` or `import 'package:ui_tv/ui_tv.dart'`
- Also need `import '../theme/arc_colors.dart';` if using `ArcColors.of(context)` directly

**DO NOT change**: `TvColors.brandRed`, `TvColors.success`, `TvColors.error`, `TvColors.warning`, `TvColors.gold` — these are semantic and theme-invariant.

**Files to update:**

### 1. `packages/ui_tv/lib/src/widgets/focusable_card.dart`
- Replace `TvColors.accentBlue` with `TvColors.accent(context)` for glow/border colors
- The widget takes an optional `glowColor` parameter — its default should use `TvColors.accent(context)` when null

### 2. `packages/ui_tv/lib/src/widgets/tv_sidebar.dart`
- Sidebar gradient: `TvColors.sidebarTop`/`TvColors.sidebarBottom` → `ArcColors.of(context).sidebarTop`/`.sidebarBottom` (need to add import for arc_colors.dart)
- Nav item focus: all `TvColors.accentBlue` → `TvColors.accent(context)` for:
  - Focus highlight background
  - Focus border color
  - Focus glow shadow
  - Icon color when focused
  - Label color when focused
- Also any `TvColors.accentIndigo` → `TvColors.accent(context)`
- `TvColors.surface` / `TvColors.surfaceElevated` → `TvColors.surf(context)` / `TvColors.surfElev(context)` if used for backgrounds
- `TvColors.textPrimary` / `TvColors.textSecondary` / `TvColors.textMuted` → `TvColors.txt(context)` / `TvColors.txtSub(context)` / `TvColors.txtMuted(context)` where used for text colors

### 3. `packages/ui_tv/lib/src/widgets/tv_stream_card.dart`
- Focus border: `TvColors.accentBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.6)` → `TvColors.accent(context).withValues(alpha: 0.6)`
- Focus glow shadow: `TvColors.accentBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.4)` → `TvColors.accent(context).withValues(alpha: 0.4)`
- Hover glow: similar pattern
- Card background if using `TvColors.card` → `TvColors.cardDyn(context)`

### 4. `packages/ui_tv/lib/src/screens/tv_settings_screen.dart`
- ALL `const Color(0xFF6366f1)` → `TvColors.accent(context)` (this was the indigo accent)
- ALL `const Color(0xFF8b5cf6)` → `TvColors.accentSec(context)` where used alongside indigo in gradients, or just `TvColors.accent(context)` for single uses
- ALL `const Color(0xFF3B82F6)` → `TvColors.accent(context)`
- `TvColors.accentIndigo` → `TvColors.accent(context)`
- Switch `activeColor: TvColors.accentIndigo` → `activeColor: TvColors.accent(context)`
- Switch `activeTrackColor: TvColors.accentIndigo.withValues(alpha: 0.4)` → `TvColors.accent(context).withValues(alpha: 0.4)`
- `_SettingsCard` container `color: TvColors.surfaceElevated` → `TvColors.surfElev(context)`
- `_SettingsCard` border → `TvColors.border(context)`
- Dropdown `dropdownColor: const Color(0xFF1e1e2e)` → `TvColors.surf(context)`
- `_SectionHeader` text color `TvColors.textMuted` → `TvColors.txtMuted(context)`
- Divider colors using `Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.06)` → `TvColors.border(context)`
- `_SettingsTile` hover background → `TvColors.surfElev(context)` with low alpha
- `_ActivateButton` and `_DialogButton` gradient colors: replace inline hex with accent
- Section header divider `Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.06)` → `TvColors.border(context)`
- Account section container gradient colors → use `TvColors.surf(context)` / `TvColors.bg(context)`

For EACH file: read it first, make all edits, then verify no remaining `TvColors.accentBlue` or `TvColors.accentIndigo` or `const Color(0xFF6366f1)` accent references.

IMPORTANT: Keep `const` keyword where possible. Only remove `const` where the color value is now dynamic (reads from context). Example: `const TextStyle(color: TvColors.textMuted)` → `TextStyle(color: TvColors.txtMuted(context))` (const removed).

Also in `tv_settings_screen.dart`, the `_AccentColorPicker._presets` list should keep its hardcoded color values — those are the picker swatches showing available options. Only the SELECTED indicator ring should use `TvColors.accent(context)`.
